Create delivery notes and convert them into invoices

Enable this module to create delivery notes, send them to your clients, and convert them into an invoice once accepted.

The delivery note number will be shown on the matching invoice for accounting traceability.

You can convert a delivery note into an invoice, and group several DNs into a single invoice.

Enable this module if you invoice under several businesses (different registration numbers, separate activities…).

You'll be able to add more businesses from "My account" and switch between them from the menu.

Your clients, products, numbering and bank details will be kept separate per business.
Export the data in a core e-invoicing format

Enable this module to export your invoices as Cross Industry Invoice (CII), an internationally recognised e-invoicing standard.

The XML data can be read by software, including e-invoicing platforms.

Unlike Factur-X, it doesn't include a PDF.
Export the data in a core e-invoicing format

Enable this module to export your invoices as Factur-X, a Franco-German e-invoicing standard.

The generated file is a regular PDF paired with a machine-readable XML file.

Useful for sending your invoices to e-invoicing platforms while keeping a human-readable PDF for the client.
For an e-invoicing compatible format, use CII or Factur-X.
